verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS fraud-prevention platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an open-source license or a public source repository. The SDKs, the MCP server and llms.txt are distribution and integration artifacts, not open-licensed source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
